P01.rationale: A large portrait of a founder/worker dominates the right side of the page as the primary visual anchor.

P05.rationale: There are no case studies or client portraits on this page; it is a summary/conclusion section.

P07.rationale: A QR code and URL act as a functional social-proof mechanism for the next step, though not a traditional press wall.

P10.rationale: The headline 'FAZIT' is oversized and acts as a dominant typographic element anchoring the top of the layout.

P11.rationale: There are no data visualisations or charts present on this page.

P12.rationale: The layout is dense and editorially structured with text columns filling the space effectively next to the image.

P13.rationale: A darkened, atmospheric background texture (the construction site) provides a strong mood appropriate for the 'consequences' theme.

P14.rationale: The full-bleed photo is treated with a heavy dark overlay to ensure text readability, though it creates a somewhat flat visual effect.

P16.rationale: A realistic device mockup (smartphone) is held by the subject in the foreground, adding tangible product credibility.

N07.rationale: The imagery appears specific to a real-world construction context rather than generic stock photography.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the text columns and image occupy most of the page area.

N10.rationale: Text sits directly on top of a busy photo background without sufficient separation or distinct framing to prevent visual clutter.
